answer: The shale is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the reef. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
